# Current regression inputs

These are focused data inputs retained while historical demonstration projects
were retired. Their source revision is
`2ee4203a0053cc545eab4a184c627f4f5507c4bd`; Git preserves the complete originals.
They are not compatibility examples or replacement historical games.

- `PlanarTrajectoryControl.h`: independent 3D trajectory control for native 2D.
- `collision/coin.judascollision`: cooked convex penetration reproduction.
- `animation`: skinned GLB and stripped animation/ragdoll component scenes;
  no original player, HUD or gameplay script.
- `ik`: small skeleton assets and one full-body IK mapping.
- `fracture/irregular.source`: nonrectangular fracture partition and strengths.
- `materials`: skinned material and texture invalidation inputs.
- `model-runtime`: cooked multipart/high-joint-count models and component data;
  no historical game controller/UI. Used for async publication and resource lifetime.
- `text`: licensed multilingual fonts and catalogs, without the text showcase.

Adjacent original licence/provenance files remain authoritative. Asset identifiers
are retained where they are part of the fixture's internal references, not to
promise compatibility with a retired game or engine API.
